# Public BeerXML fixtures

`beerxml-1.0-software-generated-examples.xml` is the official BeerXML 1.0
software-generated sample corpus. It contains four complete recipes:

- Burton Ale
- Dry Stout
- Porter
- Wit

Source: https://www.beerxml.com/recipes.xml

Downloaded: 2026-07-20

Copyright: BeerSmith LLC, as stated on https://beerxml.com/. The fixture is
retained verbatim for interoperability testing. SHA-256:
`d0617920da81064c4f4d90c4db87439c7e22903b0832ce3c215664194af60146`.

`brewtarget-default-recipes.xml` contains the 29 recipes from Brewtarget's
default-content data set. It is a UTF-8 transcription of the `<RECIPES>`
section from
https://github.com/Brewtarget/brewtarget/blob/a1087a1483e52be9a931315f25ecfc78164b3c1c/data/DefaultContent001-OriginalDefaultData.xml,
whose upstream document declares ISO-8859-1. The upstream project distributes
the data under GPL-3.0-or-later; see its `COPYING.GPLv3` file.

Downloaded and transcoded: 2026-07-20

SHA-256: `e23ec3cf38cb2aef58f2a3abee5f015be8b99c152af79c73848f634e7f97edb2`.
